title: Jack Rabbit Mandarin Cheesecake E-Liquid Shortfill 100ml
description: Jack Rabbit Vapes' Mandarin Cheesecake shortfill artfully combines the tangy zest of mandarin oranges with the smooth, rich creaminess of cheesecake, resting on a deliciously crumbly biscuit base. This e-liquid offers a gourmet vaping experience, with the vibrant citrus notes perfectly complementing the indulgent cheesecake flavour. Each puff envelops the palate in a silky-smooth blend, making for an irresistibly luxurious treat. Housed in a 120ml bottle, this shortfill contains 100ml of e-liquid, providing space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. Mixing in 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots will produce 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, giving you the flexibility to customize your nicotine strength. Formulated with a 70VG/30PG ratio, it's perfectly suited for sub-ohm vaping, delivering excellent flavour depth and substantial cloud production with high-powered vaping devices. Jack Rabbit Vapes shortfills are the perfect choice for vapers looking to enjoy high-quality, complex dessert flavours at an economical price, with the convenience of adjusting nicotine levels. Ideal for advanced sub-ohm vaping, these e-liquids cater to those who appreciate a deeper, more immersive vaping experience. Manufactured in the UK, Jack Rabbit Vapes is committed to creating premium-quality dessert and fruit blends. Their expertise in flavour blending shines through in every e-liquid, offering vapers a rich, authentic, and unforgettable taste experience.
